timelineEvents.title: Arrival in New York en route to Los Angeles
timelineEvents.label: 24 Oct 1934 · Arrival in New York
timelineEvents.shortDescription: Kaper arrives in New York from France with Eleonora, holding a temporary visa and travelling onward to Los Angeles.
timelineEvents.longDescription: Kaper and his wife Eleonora arrived in New York aboard the S.S. Champlain from Le Havre on 24 October 1934, with Los Angeles listed as their destination.

places.publicNote: French port city context for Kaper’s 1934 Atlantic crossing from Le Havre to New York aboard the S.S. Champlain. The marker is placed at city level: in 1934 CGT liners still used the port’s earlier transatlantic quays, since the landmark Gare Maritime on the quai Johannès-Couvert opened only in May 1935 (with the Normandie) and was destroyed in the 1944 bombing of Le Havre.
